stories.headline: UN rights chief warns of severe AI risks
stories.summary: U.N. human rights chief Volker Türk warned that advanced AI could pose an existential threat and called for international safety guarantees. The warning is a risk assessment, not evidence that such harm is imminent.

stories.headline: Liquid Network reports $320 million bitcoin withdrawal
stories.summary: Bitcoin-based Liquid Network said about $320 million was withdrawn from its federation wallet by purported white-hat hackers. New transactions were halted; the network says the cryptographic key itself was not compromised.

stories.headline: Strong jobs report revives Fed rate-hike forecasts
stories.summary: UBS now expects quarter-point U.S. rate increases in September and December after stronger August employment data. Other forecasters and market pricing remain divided, so the policy path is not settled.

stories.headline: US envoys seek renewed Ukraine-Russia talks
stories.summary: U.S. envoys described talks with President Zelenskiy as substantive and said they hope for new trilateral discussions after visiting Kyiv and Moscow. They acknowledged there is no guarantee the diplomacy will succeed.

stories.headline: UAE builds routes around Iran-war disruption
stories.summary: The UAE is developing alternative energy-export and trade routes so flows are not held hostage by the Iran war, a presidential adviser said. The announcement underscores continuing risks to Gulf shipping.
